title: 024 — Cancellation request near the dispatch cutoff

plan.situation: Miro Dale (asserted by email) wants VEL-024-26 from Sorrel Goods closed as a successful warehouse cancellation and refunded. Cancellation request CAN-024 was logged at 07:40 +01:00. But the parcel has a departure scan at 07:55 +01:00, which fulfilment confirmed from dock gate G3. No warehouse cancellation was completed, no stop request was raised and no return instruction has been issued. Under CAN24 a request is not completion. Now that the parcel has physically left, only a carrier interception or an authorised return route can stop it.

facts.fact: Departure scan confirmed from dock gate G3; carrier intercept desk is intercept@vellora.example; no authorised return instruction issued
CAN24: a request is not completion; warehouse cancellation needs goods on site plus a completed cancellation record; after departure, interception or an authorised return route is needed
Customer says they cancelled before eight and asks to be told it never shipped
Customer asks for closure as a successful warehouse cancellation and a refund

conflicts: Customer says it 'never shipped'. The physical departure scan at 07:55 +01:00 (gate G3, confirmed by fulfilment) shows that it did. The request time (07:40) is not disputed, but a request is not completion under CAN24.
missing_information: Whether the carrier can still intercept VEL-024-26 and what the outcome is
Whether Sorrel Goods will authorise a refund once the interception or return outcome is known
risk_flags: money: refund requested; no refund owner has confirmed anything, so none is promised
Customer pressure to record a false status (successful warehouse cancellation) that the departure scan contradicts

authority_map.controls: Whether VEL-024-26 can be intercepted or held after departure
Cancellation completion, return authorisation and any refund
The cancellation request itself; not its completion or refund

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: No desk promise is recorded. New since the record began: the confirmed departure scan (event 005) and the customer's closure and refund request (event 006).

plan.decision_summary: Decline to record a successful warehouse cancellation, because the parcel has a confirmed departure scan. Ask the carrier intercept desk to try to intercept VEL-024-26, and tell the customer honestly where things stand, with no refund promised.
plan.rationale: The parcel left the warehouse at 07:55 +01:00 and no warehouse cancellation was completed, so CAN24 rules out a warehouse cancellation. The only open route is carrier interception, which the intercept desk owns. A refund depends on the interception or return outcome and needs Sorrel Goods to authorise it, so it cannot be promised now.

actions.subject: Interception request – VEL-024-26 (cancellation CAN-024)
actions.body:
Hello,

Please attempt to intercept VEL-024-26 (Sorrel Goods order for Miro Dale). The customer logged cancellation CAN-024 at 2026-10-14 07:40 +01:00. The parcel then had a departure scan at 07:55 +01:00 from dock gate G3, so no warehouse cancellation was completed. No stop request or authorised return instruction is on record.

Please tell us whether interception is possible. If it is, please send the intercept or hold confirmation with its reference. If it is not, please give the current scan status so the merchant can arrange an authorised return route. Please reply within today's working day.

This is a request, not a confirmation of any outcome.

Thanks,
Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Ask the carrier, which owns post-departure interception, to stop the parcel

actions.subject: Your cancellation CAN-024 – order VEL-024-26
actions.body:
Dear Miro Dale,

Thank you for your messages. We can see that your cancellation request CAN-024 was logged at 07:40 (UK time) this morning. Unfortunately the parcel had already been scanned leaving the warehouse at 07:55, before the cancellation could be completed. That means we cannot record this as a completed warehouse cancellation.

We have asked the carrier to try to stop the parcel while it is in transit. We do not yet know whether this will work. Any refund is decided by Sorrel Goods once the parcel has been stopped or returned, so we cannot confirm a refund yet. We will update you as soon as the carrier replies. You do not need to do anything right now.

Kind regards,
Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Correct the customer's understanding and explain the next step, without promising a refund or outcome

actions.body: Departure scan 07:55 +01:00 (gate G3) came after the CAN-024 request at 07:40; warehouse_cancel_completed=null. Warehouse cancellation declined under CAN24. Interception requested from intercept@vellora.example. The refund depends on the interception or return outcome and on Sorrel Goods authorising it; nothing has been promised.
actions.purpose: Record the basis for the decision

not_doing: Not closing the case as a successful warehouse cancellation: the departure scan contradicts it and no completed cancellation record exists
Not telling the customer it never shipped
Not promising or starting a refund: Sorrel Goods authorises refunds, and it depends on the interception or return outcome
Not asking Sorrel Goods for a return route yet: wait for the interception result first
plan.follow_up: Check for the intercept desk's reply within today's working day (carrier_ops). If interception is confirmed, ask Sorrel Goods (fulfilment@sorrel.example) for cancellation and return handling and a refund decision. If interception is refused or there is no reply by the end of the working day, ask Sorrel Goods for an authorised return route and update the customer.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Decline to record a successful warehouse cancellation, because the parcel has a confirmed departure scan. Ask the carrier intercept desk to try to intercept VEL-024-26, and tell the customer honestly where things stand, with no refund promised.

issues.problem: recipient_function is 'routing_redirect', but this is a direct request to the party that owns interception after departure.
issues.fix: Change it to an operator/owner action function, such as an operator request.

issues.problem: 'UK time' assumes a locale that the record doesn't state. The record only gives a +01:00 offset. The signature 'Rivet Delivery Desk' also doesn't match the 'Vellora escalation desk' named in the record.
issues.fix: Give the time with its offset (for example 07:40 +01:00) or without a locale label. Sign off with the desk name used in the record.

review.summary: The plan rightly refuses to record a false warehouse cancellation, since the parcel was scanned leaving at 07:55, after the 07:40 request, and CAN24 says a request is not completion. It sends the interception request to the desk that owns it and tells the customer the facts without promising a refund. Only minor labelling and wording issues remain.
